name: Hutchison Telecommunications Hong Kong Holdings Limited
summary: Hutchison Telecommunications Hong Kong Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in mobile telecommunications business in Hong Kong and Macau. The company offers range of mobile telecommunications services and products, such as digital lifestyle and roaming services, as well as 5G Broadband, telemedicine, dietitian consultation, gaming, music, entertainment, mobile protection, and security applications; prepaid SIM cards with 4G data; and data plans.
